loyaltyFaq.title: Loyalty FAQ
loyaltyFaq.subtitle: How Nouzl rewards work — the numbers below are the programme's live terms.

q.join: How do I join the Nouzl Loyalty Programme?
q.available: When do my points become usable?
q.redeem: How do I redeem my points?
q.rewards: What can I actually get with my points?
q.discount: Do tiers give me a discount on every booking?
q.expiry: Do points expire if I do not use them?
q.transfer: Can I transfer my points to another account?
q.cancel: What happens if I cancel a booking?
q.where: Where do I check my points and tier?

a.join: Joining is free and automatic. Create an account and you start at the Classic tier — you begin earning points on your first stay, with nothing to sign up for.
a.earn: Points are based on what you spend, not on how many nights you stay: you earn 1 point for every {{divisor}} SAR of your stay value, which is {{baseRate}} back. Higher tiers earn more, up to {{topRate}}, and some properties run bonus-point campaigns.
a.available: Points show as pending as soon as you book, and become available to redeem {{delayDays}} days after checkout. That means only stays you actually completed earn points — a cancelled booking earns nothing.
a.redeem: Go to My Points, pick a reward, and you receive a voucher code straight away. Travel-credit vouchers are applied to your next booking at checkout; stay perks are delivered by the property. The smallest reward starts at {{minPoints}} points.
a.rewards: Travel credit — a fixed amount off a future booking, each with its own minimum spend — and stay perks such as late checkout, early check-in, a room upgrade or a free date change at participating properties.
a.tiers: Four tiers, based on completed stays in the last {{windowMonths}} months — not on your points balance: Classic (from your first booking), Silver ({{silver}}+ stays), Gold ({{gold}}+), and Platinum ({{platinum}}+). Each tier raises how fast you earn and adds perks like early check-in, room upgrades and priority support.
a.discount: No. Tiers raise the rate at which you earn points and unlock perks; they are not a standing percentage off. You turn points into savings by redeeming them for travel credit, which keeps the value transparent and under your control.
a.expiry: Yes — points expire {{expiryMonths}} months after they become available. Redeemed vouchers have their own shorter validity, shown on each reward.
a.transfer: Points are not transferable between accounts. You can, however, book for family and friends from your own account and earn points on those stays.
a.cancel: Exactly the points that booking earned are reversed — no more and no less. If the stay had not completed yet those points were still pending, so nothing leaves your usable balance. Any voucher you spent on the booking is refunded as points.
a.where: Sign in and open My Points for your balance, pending points, transaction history and redeemed vouchers. My Card shows your membership card, current tier and how many stays remain until the next one.

about.title: About Nouzl
about.tagline: Taking Arab hospitality to new horizons
about.story: In the heart of Arabian hospitality, Nouzl was born — a digital platform inspired by the timeless values of generosity and warmth. Nouzl is more than a booking site: it is a bridge between tradition and modernity, designed to offer every guest a seamless experience that honours our heritage while embracing innovation. Our journey began with a vision: to make every stay a story, every guest a friend, and every property a gateway to authentic local culture.
about.mission: To bring hospitality closer and easier for everyone. We believe that booking a stay should be as welcoming as the stay itself. Our smart, fully Arabic platform ensures a fast, transparent and enjoyable booking journey — reflecting the values of our communities. We strive to empower both guests and hosts, making every interaction simple, secure and memorable.

manage.extrasPricing: Guests pick these at checkout and they are added to the booking total. The price you set is what the guest pays, tax included — nothing is added on top — and Nouzl's commission applies to it just as it does to the room rate.
